name: Elhanan
bio: Elhanan son of Jaare-Oregim (called the son of Jair in 1 Chronicles 20:5), a Bethlehemite, killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite — named there as Lahmi — in another battle against the Philistines at Gob; the giant's spear shaft, like Goliath's, was as thick as a weaver's beam (2 Samuel 21:19; 1 Chronicles 20:5).
